about: Real browsers' WebAuthn answers, recorded against http://localhost:5000 (relying party localhost) by the py_webauthn project for its own tests: webauthn 2.5.2 on PyPI, tests/test_verify_registration_response.py (test_verifies_none_attestation_response) and tests/test_verify_authentication_response.py (the EC2 and RSA public key tests). Copyright (c) 2017-2021 Duo Security, Inc., BSD 3-Clause licence (ATTRIBUTIONS.md). Each answer is kept byte for byte with the challenge it answered and, for a sign-in, the public key of the credential that made it.

registration.about: A security key (usb, nfc) registering: 'none' attestation, user verified, counter 23

touchOnly.about: An ES256 credential answering a sign-in with a touch only (user not verified), counter 78, in client data with fields an older browser added; no user handle

rs256.about: An RS256 credential answering a sign-in, user verified, counter 1, with the user handle of the account it was made for on the site that recorded it
